title: Unit review quiz
subject: PSHE
source: Seeded from pshe/y4 lesson 15 (Unit review quiz (pupil PDF))
intro: Covers lessons 10 to 15 of Who likes chocolate?. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: In the example pie chart, who gets the smallest share?
questions.a: A) The farmer. 7p of the £1 in the example data.

questions.q: What does the fair trade mark tell you?
options: Farmers were paid a fair price
questions.a: A) Farmers were paid a fair price. Fair trade is about fair pay and conditions.
A) Will I really use it?. Thinking about use avoids buying things we throw away.
A) This bar weighs 45 g. A weight can be measured and checked.

questions.q: 'Collect 5 tokens for a free toy!' uses which technique?
questions.a: A) A free gift. Offers of free gifts make us buy more.

options: All people from one country are the same
questions.a: A) All people from one country are the same. Saying all people in a group are the same is a stereotype.
